attractions.name: Madu Ganga River Safari
attractions.description: Boat trip through the Madu Ganga estuary, one of Sri Lanka's largest wetland ecosystems, with mangrove tunnels, islets, cinnamon plantations and birdlife. Typically includes a mangrove tunnel cruise, a visit to Kothduwa Temple Island (free), a cinnamon island demo (peeling, oil distillation) and bird and reptile sightings.
attractions.entry_fee: ₹1,828 per adult; price varies by boat operator
tips: Go between 8:00 and 9:00 AM to avoid mid-day heat
